name: MODISA-OCSMART-DOC-DAILY
title: MODIS-Aqua Daily Dissolved Organic Carbon (DOC) - OC-SMART AC
description: The MODIS-Aqua daily Dissolved Organic Carbon (DOC, measured in umol·L-1) utilizes daily data from the MODIS sensor onboard NASA's Aqua satellite (MODIS-Aqua). This data has a nominal resolution of 1 km at nadir and is atmospherically corrected using the Ocean Color - Simultaneous Marine and Aerosol Retrieval Tool (OC-SMART) (FAN et al., 2021). The DOC estimates are obtained using an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) machine learning approach (Bonelli et al., 2022). The daily DOC products are the mosaic of several images of DOC estimates obtained for the same day and merged into daily composites utilizing the SNAP mosaicking tool.
